title: When Does the Real Wiring Win? Testing connectome structure-function claims against unmeasured physiology
abstract: arXiv:2611.14508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Connectome-constrained models are often used to argue that a measured wiring diagram outperforms shuffled or rewired wiring, and hence that structure shapes function. Such comparisons can confound wiring with how the models are tuned: a connectome fixes who connects to whom, not the excitability, gains or plasticity rates the model also needs, and modellers often tune these until the real-wiring model works. We separate three estimands: physiology tuned on the real wiring and transferred to nulls (P1), each wiring tuned on its own (P2), and P2 restricted to physiology consistent with independent data (P3). The biases involved are known in machine learning (under-tuned baselines, inherited weights, winner's curse); we measure what they do to biological conclusions, using synthetic ground truth, placebo nulls and three Drosophila circuit models. Some claims survive every protocol we test: segregated reward and punishment dopamine improves

translated_title: 真实的神经连线何时胜出？针对未测量的生理参数检验连接组结构-功能主张
translated_abstract: 连接组约束模型常被用来论证测得的神经连线图优于打乱或重新连线后的连线，从而得出“结构塑造功能”的结论。然而这类比较可能将连线本身与模型的调参方式相混淆：连接组只规定了谁与谁相连，并不规定模型所需的兴奋性、增益或可塑性速率等参数，建模者往往反复调节这些参数直到真实连线模型能够正常工作。我们区分了三种待估计对象：在真实连线上调节生理参数并迁移到零假设连线的P1；每条连线各自独立调参的P2；以及限定在与独立数据相符的生理参数范围内的P3。这些偏差在机器学习中已被认识（调参不足的基线、继承权重、赢家诅咒）；我们借助合成真值数据、安慰剂零假设以及三个果蝇神经回路模型，量化了这些偏差对生物学结论的影响。在我们测试的所有方案下，某些结论依然成立：分离的奖励与惩罚多巴胺通路能提升……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文指出连接组结构-功能比较可能混淆“连线本身”与“模型调参偏差”，提出区分三种生理参数调节方案（P1/P2/P3），并用合成真值、安慰剂零假设和三个果蝇回路模型检验哪些结构-功能结论经得起这些偏差的校正。
en_tdlr: This paper disentangles whether connectome structure-function claims reflect genuine wiring advantages or tuning biases by separating three physiology-tuning protocols (P1/P2/P3) and testing them with synthetic ground truth, placebo nulls, and three Drosophila circuit models.
